brief: An island-town cottage lot: Capt Rae House 2, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Capt. Rae House (Vermilion, 1880s): a white Italianate with paired brackets, black shutters, window boxes, a bracketed door hood, a glassed sun room on the rear wing; a white picket fence along the street; cars parked in the side drive

why.note: Vermilion OH, the village of lake captains
the picket fence marks the front yard on a captains' street
